speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the nature of your itching and fatigue. Can you tell me if your skin has become yellow (jaundiced) and have you noticed any dark urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and recent sexual activity, have you noticed any abdominal pain, fever, or changes in your bowel habits? Also, have you been taking any new medications or herbal supplements recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, scleral icterus, and your history of inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis) strongly suggests this autoimmune liver condition, which is frequently associated with other autoimmune disorders. While your sexual history raises the possibility of viral hepatitis, the chronic nature of your symptoms and lack of mentioned pain make PBC the most likely diagnosis. Please confirm if you have been tested for Anti-mitochondrial Antibodies (AMA).
